name: military-symbols
description: Figma plugin that generates NATO APP-6E (STANAG 2019 Ed. E) military map symbols

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.ui.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node build/build-test.mjs && node --test dist/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run verify && node build/package.mjs
